claim: Login form renders without console errors, submits via real POST to /api/login, and shows the success toast on a 200 response.
preconditions: Reproduced bug: login form HTML renders, but on click the WebSocket drops and the page console floods with 'WebSocket connection to ws://... failed'.
Root cause: the new auth middleware closes idle WS on /login even though login needs the channel for live validation.
Fix approved: scope the WS close to authenticated routes only.
